reasons.water_hh_strong: seed: about 1 dB below the median of calm lake water (-19.5 dB HH, 3x3 filtered, 19 Jun); lower values leave windy dates without seeds
reasons.water_hh_weak: growth limit: inside [-17.7, -15.0] dB = [95 % of calm lake, 1 % of never-wet land]; the floodplain histogram valley sits at -17 dB on calm dates
reasons.water_hv_max: HV of the lake sits at the noise floor (-25.8 dB, NESZ about -27 dB); -24 dB keeps wind-roughened water (HV barely changes) and rejects dark fields (HV -16 dB)
reasons.box: 3x3 Quegan at 80 m (240 m); the data already average 16 x ~9.5 looks (measured ENL 60-100); 7 blurs shores
reasons.quegan: multi-temporal filter in linear power (unbiased); never average in dB
reasons.refine_px: 2-px shoreline refinement on the unfiltered HH: power-domain filtering shrinks shores by ~1 px
reasons.open_k: 0: an opening of 3 deletes every channel narrower than 240 m
reasons.normalise: False: stable upland forest varies by 0.16 dB (HH) / 0.09 dB (HV) std between dates
reasons.fv_hh_rise: simple ops rule only (kept for comparison); the app should use fv_db (FV_KNOBS_db)

FV_KNOBS_db_note: distances in px for 80 m; calibrated.fv_knobs(pixel_m) scales them

stats_change.enl_note: spatial ENL on the calm lake core, per channel
stats_change.null: theoretical chi2 at the measured ENL; NOT at nominal level over 10 dates on stable forest (17 % at alpha 0.01; pairs ~1 %): add a minimum effect size, see calibrated.md section 7b

mode_note: These water thresholds are for the 20+5 MHz GCOV mode (Tonle Sap, noise floor ~-27 dB HV). The 40+5 MHz Armenia product has a ~7-8 dB higher floor: Lake Sevan sits at HH -15.3 / HV -17 dB and these knobs find 0 km2. Sevan-level HH-only diagnostic: strong -15.5 / weak -14.0, HV guard off -> 1,210-1,239 km2 (target 1,242) with 26-60 km2/date false water. Use mode-specific knobs.
